I feel guilty for not staying in touch more. It was strange talking about memories with people I used to be so close to."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That's understandable. Guilt can be hard to shake off, but reconnecting at the memorial could be a new beginning."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I hope so. I exchanged numbers with a few of them and promised to keep in touch."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That's a great step forward. How does it feel to have taken that initiative?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"A little reassuring, honestly. But there's still this nagging feeling of having missed out on so much with them."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It's natural to feel that way, but it's important to give yourself grace.
